searchText: the build.gradle doesn't specify a version so it wil run with whatever you have installed from a a quick glance it doesn't seem to use java 8 features, so anything 7+ should work but yeah, don't use that - if you want a java node, use Besu you need to know the topics you're interested in you can just take a random topic and decipher it, because it's a hash more info: https://ethereum.stackexchange.com/a/12951 Hello, where to start with eth ecosystem and DeFi with a software engineer background ? Is the book "Mastering Ethereum" worth diving in (published in 2018) ? Which educational content would you recommend please ? Hello ser, check dapp University on YouTube, I find his (Greg) tutorials to be a great way to get started with the Ethereum blockchain programing basics Thank you, will check ! i found that book to be a really helpful overview. the dapp university i found to be less helpful, but that is just my personal experience since i tend to just end up copying on video tutorials Good point. Maybe dapp University is alright for like a guided approach until you feel comfortable enough to develop by yourself Nice thanks, have you read any other book that would recommend ? I tend to prefer books than videos to be honest but both can be complementary it depends on what you want to work on ultimately in the eth ecosystem, but ethereum.org has good articles and the princeton bitcoin & cryptocurrencies also gives a pretty in-depth & rigorous overview of the tech in general

excerpts.author: norswap
excerpts.content:
the build.gradle doesn't specify a version so it wil run with whatever you have installed
from a a quick glance it doesn't seem to use java 8 features, so anything 7+ should work
but yeah, don't use that - if you want a java node, use Besu

excerpts.author: norswap
excerpts.content:
you need to know the topics you're interested in
you can just take a random topic and decipher it, because it's a hash
more info: https://ethereum.stackexchange.com/a/12951

excerpts.content: Hello, where to start with eth ecosystem and DeFi with a software engineer background ? Is the book "Mastering Ethereum" worth diving in (published in 2018) ? Which educational content would you recommend please ?
